actions.reason: RegexTokenizer.train now counts pair statistics once and updates them incrementally for only the chunks a merge actually changes (subtract old pairs, add new pairs, weighted by chunk multiplicity), instead of recounting every pair over all distinct chunks each merge step. Tie-breaking is preserved exactly: if the max count is unique (operator.countOf) it is taken directly; otherwise the chunks are scanned in order and the first pair with the max count is picked, which is exactly what max() over a freshly built (first-seen-ordered) stats dict returns. Zero-count pairs are deleted so the empty-stats ValueError behaviour is kept. Affected chunks are found with C-level compress/map(contains). train_ir ratio 0.644, equivalence identical.
